guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), flex-wrap: wrap for wrapping lists, and overflow: auto for wide tables without overflow: hidden clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% with horizontal scrolling on the 4-column minimization and compatibility tables, and .baseline-browsers inherits flex-wrap: wrap from /public/styles.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic navigation landmarks focus visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, and explicit :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, and 3px :focus-visible outline on .table-wrap.
